Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Events | Music | Theatre Nacee announces star-studded second edition of KAVOD for November 8 Source : Amelley Djosu 28 October 2026 2:21pm Audio By Carbonatix
Award-winning musician, song writer and record producer Nacee is preparing to stage the second edition of his entertainment event, KAVOD 26 , at the National Theatre in Accra on Sunday, November 8, 2026.
Scheduled to begin at 5 p.m., the event will combine live gospel music, theatrical performances and stand-up comedy, bringing musicians, actors and comedians together for a single production.
The musical lineup includes Nacee, Soul Winners, Cindy Thompson, Kofi Peprah, Yvonne Mends and Joe Mettle.
The theatrical segment will feature Vivian Jill, Killer Ntua, Clemento Suarez, Foster Romanus, Deaconess Abokoma, Jeneral Ntatia and DeLong, among others.
The comedy lineup includes Jacinta, Parrot Mouth, Jeffrey Nortey, Comedy Boy and Visa Boy, Adam Best and G.H. Pookie.
KAVOD returns after its maiden edition at the National Theatre on November 26, 2023, when Nacee introduced a format that extended beyond a conventional gospel concert.
The first edition combined music with a stage play inspired by the musician’s personal journey, exploring his humble beginnings, early struggles and eventual progress in the music industry.
The production also examined his work across gospel and secular music, his involvement in political campaign songs and the challenges he encountered while building his career.
Comedians Foster Romanus and Clemento Suarez led a notable segment featuring a fictional radio discussion. The scene explored public debate surrounding Nacee’s collaboration with rapper Guru on the song Boys Boys .
The production reached a climax when Nacee emerged from beneath the stage dressed in white and launched into a live musical performance. Finalists from the Aseda Open Verse Challenge also performed a medley of songs.
The maiden edition attracted several prominent personalities, including gospel musicians Sonnie Badu, Empress Gifty and Piesie Esther, alongside political figures and other entertainment industry stakeholders.
The 2026 edition will again bring together music, comedy and theatre, continuing the event’s approach of combining different forms of live entertainment in one production.
Standard tickets are priced at GH¢200, while VIP tickets cost GH¢300. For tickets and enquiries, patrons can call 0597143961.
The event is being promoted under the tagline “KAVOD 26: Where Comedy Meets Theatre and Music.”
